name: Arlberghaus - Walserstube
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Arlberghaus – Walserstube in Zürs**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, our cozy **Arlberghaus** in **Zürs** invites you to experience authentic **Tiroler** hospitality with a rustic charm. After an exciting day on the slopes of **Lech Zürs**, warm up in our traditional **Walserstube**—where hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and **Schlutzkrapfen** await you.

Savor the flavors of the region while enjoying panoramic views of the **Lechquellengebirge**. Whether you're craving a comforting bowl of **Tiroler** beef goulash or a sweet **Apfelstrudel**, our menu is crafted with local ingredients to delight your taste buds.

Relax in our inviting atmosphere, where the crackling fireplace and the scent of freshly baked bread create the perfect retreat. After dinner, unwind with a glass of **Tiroler** wine or a frothy **Tiroler** beer—because every meal should end with a toast to the mountains.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Arlberghaus** is your ideal base for exploring the wonders of **Tirol**. Whether you're skiing, hiking, or simply soaking in the alpine scenery, we promise an unforgettable stay in the heart of **Zürs**.
